messages:
nina: heads-up: hit a nasty edge with async tool_call + structured_output when transport retries concatenate streaming chunks across attempts. the coercer then happily maps the mangled JSON into the wrong dataclass variant.

omar: ugh. can you show a tiny repro and which SDK+transport?

nina: redwood 0.15.1, httpx async. minimal flow: streaming tool emits JSON object as chunks. first attempt fails mid-stream (connection reset) -> transport retry reopens stream and sends second object, but because of a bug the buffered partial bytes from attempt1 get prepended to attempt2's JSON and we get something like: `{"id":"1","score":0.8}{"code":404,"msg":"not found"}` as a single token stream. coercer splits heuristically and ends up constructing the success dataclass with id="1" and score=0.8 while downstream expected Error variant.

lee: so two problems: (1) retry concatenates partial stream instead of discarding partial attempt, (2) coercer is too permissive when fed concatenated payloads.

nina: exactly. workaround was to disable streaming (use non-stream tool_call) or add server-side idempotency, but neither is ideal.

omar: proposed fix: transport should drop buffered partials when a retry occurs (only final success stream should be fed to higher layers). coercer should also validate that the entire input was consumed by the matched schema (no leftover tokens).

lee: agree. also add an opt-in strict_mode on structured_output so coercion fails instead of silently picking a variant. that'd help users detect upstream mangles.

nina: filing reproducible issue and attaching small harness. devex-bot: create issue?

devex-bot: created RW-4300 "async-stream-retry: partial-buffered-chunks + permissive-coercion lead to wrong dataclass variant" assigned to @omar. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/RW-4300

omar: I'll take it. plan: (a) make httpx transport drop partial buffer on retry; (b) add strict_mode + consumed-by-parser check; (c) update async quickstart + cookbook with streaming assembly pattern and a note about idempotency/retries.

nina: tiny feature request: a helper `client.tool_stub("web_search")` that emits typed dataclass + typed async helper would make onboarding much nicer.

omar: noted, adding to the ticket. please paste the small repro in the ticket and include httpx version/env. thanks!

nina: done, thanks :thumbsup:
